speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I understand you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To begin our evaluation, how old are you, and for how long has the bleeding been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial carcinoma.

Given the patient's age and the 2-month history of postmenopausal bleeding, an endometrial biopsy is the most critical next step to rule out malignancy. I will also request a Pelvic Ultrasound to further characterize the adnexal mass.
